purpose: One bounded real-observation latent fine-tune followed by one episode-level predictor gate. Planner-ranking requires a separate freeze.

source_data.recovery_boundary: 25543623 exited 1 after writing all 80 episodes and 141 NPZ samples because final json.dumps passed flush as an encoder option. Train only if independent CPU PBS recovery 25543843 validates the unmodified NPZ/summary and creates collection_summary_recovered.json; preserve the original failure history.
source_data.terminal_window_rule: Some frozen train episodes end before a complete 25-step window. Do not replace or extend them; sample uniformly only among collection_train episode IDs with at least one complete recorded window. Report the usable count. This treatment-independent availability rule is fixed before any finetuning or validation prediction.
source_data.validation_use: Use only after all 500 updates and the terminal checkpoint are saved. No early stopping, checkpoint selection, or tuning.
source_data.reserved_untouched_holdout: Do not read, evaluate, score, or use the remaining 8 prior reserved episodes for a decision.

student.implementation: Reuse lewm-transfer/run_lewm_recurrent_student.py make_student('baseline') and recurrent_loss; no new architecture.
student.input_history: Pass z_start as [B,1,192]; existing student repeat-left-pads the available H=1 history.
student.feedback: Fully autoregressive predicted-latent feedback; no teacher forcing.

training.episode_sampling: Uniform sample of 8 distinct collection_train episode IDs with at least one complete window per update; within each selected episode sample uniformly from its complete t0/t25 windows. No task replacement or validation sampling.
training.objective: Existing mean-normalized horizon-weighted recurrent MSE between free-running predictions and real official H=1 poststep observation latents.
training.checkpoint_selection: Save only terminal update-500 checkpoint before running the fixed validation gate.

predictor_gate.scope: One paired evaluation on the 16 collection_validation episodes, comparing initial and terminal checkpoints on the same complete recorded tuples.
predictor_gate.unit: Episode. Average available t0/t25 window relative-MSE values within each episode before cross-episode aggregation.
predictor_gate.relative_mse: mean((predicted_real_latent - observed_real_latent)^2) / max(mean(observed_real_latent^2), 1e-8), over five token-boundary latents and 192 dimensions.
predictor_gate.decision: PASS only if every condition passes. Otherwise record NO-GO or INCONCLUSIVE and stop; do not tune or repeat on these validation episodes.
predictor_gate.planner_ranking: NOT_RUN_BY_THIS_JOB; requires a separate pre-frozen gate.

compute.execution: PBS GPU compute allocation only; login nodes are limited to submission and lightweight status checks.
allocation_guards: current host is in PBS nodefile

scope.this_job_authorizes: Exactly one 500-update fine-tune and terminal paired predictor gate on the 16 collection_validation episodes.

claim_boundary: PASS supports only lower five-step real-observation latent error on this student-driven task-level validation split. It does not establish teacher-objective ranking, planner behavior, inference speed, or closed-loop success.
